capabilities.description: Cover Studio admin page: collection list, per-collection options, live previews, and manual rebuilds.
Rebuilds collection covers (mosaic poster + backdrop) for the enabled collections.

fields.description: Vio/Silo server URL (the address the web app opens on, not the Jellyfin-compatible port).
fields.label: Server URL

fields.description: Vio/Silo administrator API key (Admin > API keys). Used to read collections and upload covers.
fields.label: Server API Key

fields.description: TMDB API key (v3) or read access token (v4). Used to pull collection logos automatically.
fields.label: TMDB API Key

fields.description: Collection IDs to manage, one per line (find them on the Cover Studio admin page). Leave blank to manage every manual collection.
fields.label: Collections

fields.description: Overlay on each cover: the auto-pulled TMDB logo, the collection title as text, or nothing.
fields.label: Overlay

fields.description: Hours between automatic rebuilds of a collection. The admin page can always force a rebuild.
fields.label: Refresh (hours)

global_config_schema.description: Which collections get generated covers and how they look.
global_config_schema.title: Cover Studio

presentation.description_markdown: Generates Betterer-style mosaic covers for your collections — member posters arranged in a grid, spotlight, or columns layout, overlaid with the auto-pulled TMDB logo or the collection title — and keeps them updated on a schedule. Portrait covers go to the collection poster, landscape to the backdrop.
presentation.setup_markdown: Enter your Vio/Silo server URL and an administrator API key, plus a TMDB API key for automatic logos. Pick the collections to manage (leave blank for all manual collections), choose the overlay and layout, and press Rebuild Now on the Cover Studio admin page for the first run.
